summary: The retry loop retries every error, including declined cards, and can charge a customer twice.

findings.title: Retrying a charge can bill the customer twice
findings.summary: A POST to /charges is retried after any error, even when the first one reached the provider.
findings.background: Charges are not idempotent unless an idempotency key is sent.
findings.problem: A timeout after the provider accepted the charge triggers a second charge.
findings.suggestedFix: Send an idempotency key with the charge, and retry only on network errors.
findings.suggestedComment: Retrying this POST can charge the customer twice: send an idempotency key, or retry only on network errors.

findings.title: Name the retry limit
findings.summary: The literal 3 is the retry limit.
findings.background: A named constant documents the intent.
findings.problem: The magic number hides the policy.
findings.suggestedComment: Nit: extract the 3 into a MAX_CHARGE_ATTEMPTS constant.
